title: Documentation to Deployment Handoff Artifact
description: Structured artifact produced by the Documentation Orchestrator and consumed by the Deployment Orchestrator. Contains the knowledge base manifest, README reference, runbook list, ADR index, and decision log reference.

schemaVersion.description: Version of this schema used to produce the artifact.

projectName.description: Human-readable name of the target project as configured in This Project.

knowledgeBaseManifest.description: List of all documentation files produced during the Documentation phase, organized by type.

filePath.description: Relative path to the documentation file within the project repository.

readmePath.description: Relative path to the project README file (e.g., 'README.md'). This file must exist at the path stated.

runbooks.description: List of operational runbook files with their scope and intended audience.

filePath.description: Relative path to the runbook file.

scope.description: What operational scenario this runbook covers (e.g., 'Deployment', 'Incident Response', 'Database Backup').

audience.description: Who this runbook is written for (e.g., 'Operations team', 'On-call engineer').

adrIndex.description: Index of all ADRs produced across the Architecture and Development phases.

totalCount.description: Total number of ADRs in the index.

indexFilePath.description: Relative path to the ADR index file.

filePath.description: Relative path to the ADR file.

decisionLog.description: Reference to the compiled decision history covering all SDLC phases.

filePath.description: Relative path to the decision log file.

totalDecisions.description: Total number of decisions documented in the log.

phasesCovered.description: SDLC phases whose decisions are included in the log.

ticketKey.description: Optional validated TICKET_KEY scoping this run to knowledge-base/plans/active/<TICKET_KEY>/. Must match the pattern ^[A-Z][A-Z0-9]+-[1-9][0-9]*$. Absent for offline runs.

sessionPath.description: Optional active artifact directory derived from ticketKey. Defaults to knowledge-base/plans/active/ when absent.
